features.title: One-tap edits
features.body: Pro headshot, a four-shot headshot pack, old-photo restore, 3D figurine, natural retouch, white background, anime style, magazine cover, new outfit or hairstyle, travel photo, royal pet portrait and a Halloween costume.

features.title: Refine by chat
features.body: Each message edits your latest image: "make the blazer navy", "put her in a bright office". Or describe a brand-new picture from scratch.

features.title: Before and after
features.body: Save results to Photos, or share the original and the edit side by side in one tap.

features.title: Three engines
features.body: Nano Banana 2 is fast and affordable, Nano Banana Pro brings sharper detail and text, and GPT Image adds size, quality and transparent-background controls.

features.title: Pay per image
features.body: Start with 3 free images. After that, buy a credit pack once and create whenever you like; credits never expire, and a declined request never costs you anything.

features.title: Private by default
features.body: Your images are yours alone: there is no public feed, nothing you make is shown to other users, and choosing a photo never asks for access to your whole library.

howItWorks.body: Choose any photo: a selfie, an old print, your pet. Nothing asks for access to your whole library.
Tap a one-tap edit and the result arrives in seconds, made by Google's Nano Banana.
Ask for changes in plain words and each message edits the latest image, then save or share the before and after.

faq.a: No. There are no subscriptions and no renewals. You buy credit packs once and spend them as you create, and credits never expire.

The app is free to download and every new user gets 3 free images. After that you buy credit packs, with bigger packs carrying up to 68% bonus credits. A Nano Banana 2 image costs 21 credits and a Nano Banana Pro image 41.

faq.q: What can I do in one tap?
faq.a: Turn a selfie into a pro headshot or a pack of four, restore and colorize an old photo, become a 3D figurine, retouch a portrait naturally, cut a subject onto a white background, or try anime, magazine-cover, outfit, hairstyle, travel, royal-pet and Halloween looks.

faq.q: Which AI models does it use?
faq.a: Google's Nano Banana 2 and Nano Banana Pro, and OpenAI's GPT Image. One-tap edits run on Nano Banana.

faq.q: What happens to my prompts and photos?
faq.a: Your prompts and photos are sent to Google Gemini and OpenAI to create your images. You approve this in-app before your first creation and can withdraw consent anytime in Settings.

faq.q: Do I need an account to use it?
faq.a: No. You can start anonymously. To sync your images across devices, sign in with Apple, Google, or GitHub.

faq.q: What if the AI declines my request?
faq.a: Some photos and prompts are declined by content moderation, most often on photos of people. You are never charged for a declined request, and rewording it usually works.
PixiePocket runs on iPhone and iPad with iOS 16.6 or later.

faq.q: Is PixiePocket available in my language?
faq.a: Yes. The app speaks English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.
